_comment: A conventional audit log. No signatures, no hashes, no verifier material. Records what happened, in order. This is what most organizations produce today.

payload.plan_text: Empiric coverage for community-acquired pneumonia. Consider amoxicillin as first-line...

payload.content: Recommend amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg twice daily for 7 days...

payload.revised_at_decision: Accept amoxicillin-clavulanate. Duration shortened to 5 days pending clinical response...

payload.decision_text: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg twice daily for 5 days. De-escalate to amoxicillin if afebrile at 48 hours.
